snippet.title: Lady Dracula - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624840/Lady_Dracula/
Follow on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/gothdonutgames.bsky.social
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/goth-donut-games

An evolution of the Classicvania genre and a return to the glory days of precision platforming, retro challenge and gothic atmosphere. Transform yourself into a wraith, a spider and a bat to fly, climb and blast your way across Transylvania to do battle with Lady Dracula at her castle keep in LADY DRACULA, the new Classicvania from Goth Donut Games, coming 2025!
